description: This file contains test routines and scripts for testing protocol disabling and configuration in Git, including functions for testing clone, fetch, and push operations with different protocol allow settings and wrappers setup.

methods.name: test_allow_var
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, and push operations with GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL environment variable, including various enable/disable scenarios and precedence checks.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, and push with protocol-specific configurations and environment variables, including global config and user allow settings.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Sets up and runs tests for specific protocols by calling 'test_allow_var' and 'test_config'.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up an SSH wrapper script that simulates SSH access during tests.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a wrapper for remote repository access in tests, simulating remote-ext behavior.
